jobs.description: You’re joining manda, iwoca’s M&A platform, at a pivotal moment. After early success working with existing iwoca customers, we’re now turning to the open market to help more business owners exit. That’s why we’re looking for a Growth Associate to join the team. This is a 6-month fixed-term role for someone smart, hungry and entrepreneurial. With the right traction the role will convert into a permanent role at the forefront of manda’s growth efforts. The company Selling a small business is hard. Only one in five UK SME owners has a formal exit plan, yet half are counting on their business to fund their retirement. Below £10m in enterprise value, most M&A advisers can't make the economics work, so a generation of owner-managers is getting ready to step back with no realistic route to a sale. manda exists to fix that. We match owners with serious buyers, from search funds to private equity, and handle the whole process in one place, including financial due diligence and acquisition finance. Our first sale is done, and we're now opening manda up beyond iwoca's own customers. manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders, which has provided more than £4 billion in funding to over 150,000 businesses since 2012. That gives us what a traditional adviser doesn't have: a deep footprint in the SME economy, a lender's data and infrastructure, and deals run on clean, automated processes rather than spreadsheets. The team You'll report to manda's Venture Lead and work day to day with our Transaction Managers, the dealmakers who run each sale, and our Partnerships Manager, who builds our referral network with accountants, solicitors and wealth managers. You'll also work with iwoca's marketing & sales team and have access to their tools and know-how.
